title: Persons Arrested
pdf_title: 72 ## 3 ·4 Persons arrested under local and special laws A total of 28,26,118 persons were arrested during 1977 for committing various offences under local & special laws against the figures of 34,48,324 during 1976. Thus a decline was recorded in the number of arrests by 18·0 per cent in 1977 over 1976. The highest number of persons booked were (638548) under the offence 'Prohibition', the percentage being 22·6 to total. The other offences accounted for 19·7 per cent under 'Motor Vehicles Act' and 11·6 per cent under 'Gambling Act'. The pattern of arrests under different offences was more or less, the same as was recorded during 1976. The relevant statistics are presented in Table-23 and 24.
